questions.prompt: In lab status, what does the ⏭ mark mean?

options.b: locked until the previous lab passes
options.c: forced past with --force — it will never show ✓

questions.prompt: Which file at the repo root stores your progress?

options.a: the full lab.md of your last lab
options.b: the last passed lab's 3-line recap, plus the next lab and its one-line brief
